lens: Strict simulated Masaya Matsuura lens: rhythm, readable success, and rules/rewards. An interpretive evaluation, not the real person's opinions.
strengths: Musical teaching has a concrete call-and-response form: each place sings its counted steps for two bars, and the same Line anticipates and lights those steps.
Success has several connected expressions: a theme note, a gold Line peak, scheduled light and vibration, and a growing cube frame. Output latency and finger-down timing receive explicit treatment.
The World rewards timing positively: an off-time crystal retains its base value; on-time play doubles it, and an eight-hit streak triples it. The pickup displays the multiplier.
Vacío turns rhythm into an authored spatial memory: release on the first beat, move to give each star room, and hear the released note return a bar later. This is a strong rule-to-image idea.

issues.finding: A valid musical beat can advance the theme while Vacío returns wait or crowded and makes no chapter progress. The implementation intentionally distinguishes these outcomes through white marks and suppressed landing feedback, but whether players understand the two meanings of success is untested. This is not classified as a rules defect.
issues.remedy: Test whether a first-time player can explain a valid beat that did not release a star. If needed, give the existing wait/crowded feedback a more distinct visual shape or brief response, preserving the musical success.

issues.kind: verified visual constraint; usability impact untested
issues.finding: The only rhythm guide sits at 80% of screen height, while the cube is near the center; counted marks start at only two pixels wide and five pixels high. In the supplied 390-pixel screenshots the rhythm guide is substantially less prominent than nearby world objects. Precise reading requires attention away from the cube.
issues.remedy: Increase the existing guide's first-beat and target-marker distinction, especially during teaching, then test target identification on a phone without enlarging the cube or adding another guide.

evidence: Read AGENTS.md, then only the requested seven source/test files. README, HANDOFF, PANEL and historical scores were excluded under the coordinator's blind exception.
Viewed supplied static Llanura and Vacío screenshots at 390 × 844.

Focused Node probe of journey-pulse.initialize with a valid step-4 beat and chapter action wait returned true, hits=1, next=1, notes=[57], action=wait, and unchanged form. This confirms the separate musical/chapter outcomes; it does not establish a defect.

Read smoke assertions for off-time/on-time rewards, eight-hit multiplier, mute behavior, theme completion, haptics persistence, and phone/desktop Line rendering. Did not execute these tests or a full suite.
limits: Scores use a 0–10 scale in half-point steps. Audio is a provisional technical score from scheduling, latency, voice and feedback code; no audio was heard.
Sensation is null because there was no direct interactive play, physical haptic observation, or human testing.
Visual score covers the supplied still screenshots and drawing code; animation quality, instruction timing and phone readability in motion remain unobserved.
Full CI passing was reported by the coordinator and was not independently rerun or verified in this review.
